runtime_scope: Unchanged original resolver module in Node VM, verified Git blob. Explicit Map-based memoize adapter and deterministic resolveSync adapter; native fs used for owned missing-then-created file case. Real enhanced-resolve/lodash and Webpack not run.
findings: Exact key expression concatenates unescaped request/context delimiter. Pairs (a _____ /root/b, /root/c) and (a, /root/b _____ /root/c) collide and second lookup reuses first result under explicit memoization adapter. Authored path strings demonstrate key ambiguity, not observed real build input.

An exception from underlying resolver becomes original request string and is memoized. Creating the missing file afterwards does not invoke resolver again for that pair; a newly created resolver sees file. This is lifetime-of-instance behavior, not proof all builds/watch modes reuse an instance.
